zh.title: 美羅二軍於波蘭舉行反無人機演習 獵豹戰車追蹤第一人稱無人機
zh.summary: 美軍與羅馬尼亞軍於波蘭開展演習；獵豹戰車追蹤美軍無人機；型號與數量未公開
body: 美國陸軍第五軍（US Army V Corps）發布消息指出，美軍無人機操作人員與羅馬尼亞部隊於2026年8月18日在波蘭貝莫沃皮斯基訓練區（Bemowo Piskie Training Area）舉行聯合反無人機演習。演練期間，美軍操縱第一人稱視角（FPV）無人飛行器，供羅馬尼亞官兵使用獵豹式防空戰車（Flakpanzer Gepard）進行目標追蹤。
根據美軍第五軍說明，本次演習使用的無人機來自第37裝甲團第2營總部暨總部連 strike 單位。軍方目前未公開具體的無人機型號名稱，亦未透露演習期間共操縱了多少架飛行器。獵豹式防空戰車配備搜尋與追蹤雷達，並輔以光學瞄準裝置。
派駐波蘭的羅馬尼亞單位為「鐵獵豹」防空派遣隊（Iron Cheetahs），代號為 GBAD XIX，由羅馬尼亞陸軍第348營負責組建。該部隊隸屬於北大西洋公約組織（NATO）波蘭前沿陸軍戰鬥群，由同時擔任美軍營長的史蒂芬·薩克森中校（Lieutenant Colonel Steven Saxion）指揮。
獵豹式防空戰車為一款雷達導向的防空砲系統，最早於1960年代研發，並於1970年代投入西德陸軍服役。該系統採用豹1型（Leopard 1）底盤，裝備兩門35公釐歐瑞康（Oerlikon）機砲。德軍已於2010年退役該型裝備，目前該系統已停產，羅馬尼亞為少數仍在使用該裝備的北約成員國之一。
除了地面防空追蹤演練外，北約戰機於2026年間亦多次執行無人機處置任務。羅馬尼亞空軍一架 F-16 戰鬥機於2026年8月20日在黑海海域執行任務時，曾使用機砲成功擊毀一艘海上無人艇。

en.title: US and Romanian Forces Conduct Joint Counter-Drone Drill in Poland
en.summary: US and Romanian forces held a counter-drone drill in Poland; Gepard crew tracked FPV drones
body: US Army V Corps announced that US Army drone operators flew first-person-view aircraft during a joint counter-drone training exercise at Bemowo Piskie Training Area in Poland on August 18, 2026. The training exercise allowed Romanian military crews to practice tracking the unmanned aerial vehicles using a Flakpanzer Gepard anti-aircraft gun system.

According to US Army V Corps, the unmanned aircraft used during the exercise were operated by the strike section of Headquarters and Headquarters Company, 2nd Battalion, 37th Armored Regiment. Military officials did not publicly identify the specific drone model or disclose the exact number of aircraft flown during the drill. The Gepard anti-aircraft gun system utilizes search and tracking radars alongside optical targeting sights.

The Romanian unit stationed in Poland is the Iron Cheetahs air defense detachment, designated as GBAD XIX and generated by the 348th Battalion. The detachment operates as part of the NATO Forward Land Forces Battle Group-Poland, which is currently commanded by Lieutenant Colonel Steven Saxion, who also serves as the commander of the US battalion.

The Gepard is a radar-directed anti-aircraft gun system originally developed in the 1960s to engage low-flying aircraft and entered West German service during the 1970s. Built on a Leopard 1 tank chassis, the vehicle is armed with twin 35 mm Oerlikon automatic cannons. Germany retired its own Gepard fleet in 2010, and the system is no longer in active production, leaving Romania among the few NATO allies still operating the vehicle type.

In addition to ground-based air defense training, NATO combat aircraft have engaged unmanned aerial threats on multiple occasions throughout 2026. A Romanian Air Force F-16 fighter jet intercepted and neutralized a maritime drone using a gun pass over the Black Sea on August 20, 2026.

zh.title: 澳洲航空延後伯斯至倫敦直飛航線復飛時間至2027年
zh.summary: 澳洲航空將伯斯至倫敦西向直飛航線延至2027年2月恢復，期間中途停靠新加坡。
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）宣布推遲其伯斯至倫敦直飛航班服務的恢復時間至2027年2月。這項網路調整主要適用於2026年10月25日至2027年1月31日期間營運的西向QF9航班，搭乘該航班從伯斯前往倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）的旅客，將繼續經由新加坡進行中途加油與停靠。
根據澳洲航空公佈的營運計畫，東向從倫敦返回伯斯的航班服務將在整個期間內保持全程直飛，不受本次新加坡中轉安排的影響。
除了伯斯至倫敦航線外，澳洲航空亦將在同一時期調整其雪梨至巴黎航線的營運模式。自2026年10月25日至2027年1月31日，雪梨至巴黎的服務將改為經由新加坡營運，而非原先規律中轉的伯斯。至於巴黎返回雪梨的返程航班服務則保持不變。
澳洲航空亦配合新機隊的引進調整多條國際與國內航線。布里斯本至馬尼拉航線將繼續使用空中巴士（Airbus）A330客機營運至2027年1月31日，並於2027年2月1日起開始改由空中巴士A321XLR機型執飛。此外，自10月25日起，澳洲航空將在連結雪梨、墨爾本與布里斯本等關鍵國內航線上，增加更多由A321XLR執飛的航班。
在機場合作與基礎設施方面，澳洲航空集團已與墨爾本機場（MEL）就關鍵商業條款達成協議。這項協議為澳洲航空未來增加航班數量、升級國際航廈貴賓室、改善旅客報到程序，以及配合墨爾本機場交付第三條跑道鋪平了道路。

en.title: Qantas Delays Return of Nonstop Perth-London Flights Until February 2027
en.summary: Qantas delays nonstop Perth to London flights until February 2027 and extends Singapore stopovers.
body: Qantas has pushed back the return of its nonstop Perth-London flight service until February 2027, extending an intermediate Singapore refuelling stop on the ultra-long-haul route for another three months. The change applies specifically to westbound QF9 services operating between 25 October 2026 and 31 January 2027, with passengers travelling from Perth to London Heathrow (LHR) continuing to route through Singapore.

The airline confirmed that the eastbound London-Perth flight service will remain nonstop throughout the entire period. In contrast, westbound passenger flights will continue to include the intermediate technical stopover in Singapore throughout this schedule adjustment window.

Qantas will separately alter its Sydney-Paris flight service over the exact same period. From 25 October 2026 until 31 January 2027, the service will operate via Singapore rather than Perth, while the return Paris-Sydney flight service will remain completely unchanged during these network adjustments.

The airline is also making several network adjustments across its international and domestic routes in connection with the introduction of its incoming Airbus A321XLR fleet. The carrier will continue operating its Brisbane-Manila service with the Airbus A330 until 31 January 2027, before introducing the A321XLR on the route from 1 February. From 25 October, Qantas will also add more A321XLR-operated flights on key domestic routes linking Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane.

Separately, the Qantas Group and Melbourne Airport (MEL) have agreed on key commercial terms for major airport infrastructure developments. The agreement clears the way for additional flights, upgraded international lounges, improved passenger check-in procedures, and the delivery of Melbourne Airport's third runway project.

zh.title: Cosmic推進Cosmic One電動飛機計畫 預計2028年首飛
zh.summary: Cosmic發布Cosmic One電動飛機，預計2028年首飛、2029年交付。
body: 總部位於美國丹佛的新創航空業者Cosmic Aerospace公布旗下「Cosmic One」四座全電動飛機的開發與交付時程。根據公司規劃，Cosmic One原型機預計於2028年進行首次試飛，並計畫於2029年正式開始向客戶交付。首批生產的100架飛機將組成「創始者系列」（Founder Series），後續亦將持續進行量產，主要瞄準私人機主、飛行俱樂部與飛行訓練機構等通用航空市場。
該項開發計畫主要受惠於美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）推行的「特別適航檢定現代化」（MOSAIC）法規架構。MOSAIC架構擴大了輕型運動飛機（LSA）類別的認證範疇，包含取消原有的重量上限限制、將最大飛行速度上限提升至250節、允許四座座艙配置，並開放使用新型替代動力系統，為電動飛機的商業認證提供了明確的法規途徑。
在市場發展與訂單方面，飛行俱樂部Centennial Flyers已簽約成為Cosmic One的起始機隊客戶。此外，製造商表示在產品正式發布約三週內，已收到多筆來自私人機主的訂金，顯示通用航空市場對於採用新一代電動動力技術的飛機具備實質需求與興趣。
Cosmic Aerospace高層表示，開發並認證Cosmic One除了開拓通用航空市場外，更重要的是建立製造與法規認證實力。公司計畫以Cosmic One驗證其電動推進技術架構與營運模式，為未來研發規模更大的「Skylark」區域電動客機奠定堅實的技術與實務基礎。

en.title: Cosmic Aerospace Details Cosmic One Electric Aircraft Development for 2028 First Flight
en.summary: Cosmic Aerospace plans to fly its electric Cosmic One in 2028 with deliveries starting in 2029.
body: US startup Cosmic Aerospace, based in Denver, has outlined development plans for its Cosmic One four-seat all-electric aircraft. According to the company, the prototype is scheduled to make its maiden flight in 2028, with commercial customer deliveries targeted to begin in 2029. The initial 100 production aircraft will form a designated Founder Series, after which serial production is expected to continue beyond the initial batch to serve private aircraft owners, flight clubs, and pilot training providers.

The company's program timeline aligns with the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Modernisation of Special Airworthiness Certification (MOSAIC) regulatory framework. The MOSAIC rules expand certification parameters within the Light Sport Aircraft category by removing previous weight restrictions, raising the maximum airspeed limit to 250 knots, permitting four-seat cabin configurations, and allowing alternative propulsion systems necessary for commercial electric aircraft qualification.

Commercial traction for Cosmic One includes flying club Centennial Flyers signing as the launch fleet customer for the platform, alongside initial financial deposits collected from private owner-operators within approximately three weeks of the aircraft's initial product launch. Cosmic Aerospace reported additional interest from other fleet operators seeking to transition away from legacy piston-engine general aviation platforms toward electric aircraft.

Cosmic Aerospace leadership emphasized that Cosmic One serves both as a general aviation commercial product and as a technological foundation. Operating and certifying the four-seat aircraft is intended to validate the company's electric propulsion stack while establishing essential manufacturing processes, supply chains, and regulatory certification experience required prior to developing its larger Skylark electric regional airliner project.

zh.title: 瑞士CELLSIUS團隊氫燃料電池飛機移師派耶恩機場（VIP）進行首飛準備
zh.summary: 瑞士學生團隊將H2-Sling氫能實驗機移至派耶恩機場（VIP）；進行首飛前最終準備
body: 隸屬於瑞士蘇黎世聯聯邦理工學院（ETH Zurich）的學生工程團隊 CELLSIUS Aero，已將其研發的 H2-Sling 氫燃料電池實驗飛機從原建造地瑞士迪邦多夫（Dübendorf），移師至洛桑附近的派耶恩機場（VIP；Payerne Airport）。此項運送標誌著該項目已進入實際飛行前的最終準備階段，團隊將在該營運中機場完成各項首飛前整備作業。
H2-Sling 機種基於 Sling High Wing 機身架構進行改裝，採用氫電混合動力系統取代傳統內燃機。其動力核心配備額定功率 100 千瓦（kW）的燃料電池系統，經過測試後最大推進功率可達 105 千瓦；同時搭載一座容量為 5.6 千瓦時（kWh）的緩衝電池，用於因應起飛等階段的高動力需求變化。該機最大起飛重量為 1,050 公斤。
在氣體儲存與設計效能方面，H2-Sling 於兩翼下方的雙高壓儲氣罐中儲存 5.2 公斤的高壓氫氣，儲存壓力達 700 bar。該機設計可載運兩名乘客，團隊目標為實現 125 英里（相當於 200 公里）的航程、約 2 小時的飛行時間，以及每小時 100 英里（相當於 162 公里）巡航速度。
CELLSIUS 團隊於 2025 年底首度公開 H2-Sling 概念，並於 2026 年期間持續進行地面測試與監管申請作業。此前，該團隊曾於 2022 年成功試飛全純電池動力的 e-Sling 飛機，其航程為 112 英里（180 公里）。雖然蘇黎世聯邦理工學院尚未正式確認具體日程，但當地媒體報導指出，首飛預計可能於 8 月底前進行。

en.title: Swiss Student Team Prepares H2-Sling Hydrogen Aircraft for Maiden Flight
en.summary: Swiss team CELLSIUS transfers the H2-Sling hydrogen fuel-cell aircraft to Payerne Airport (VIP) for final maiden flight preparations.
body: A Swiss student engineering team affiliated with ETH Zurich, CELLSIUS Aero, has transferred its H2-Sling hydrogen fuel-cell demonstrator aircraft from its construction site in Dübendorf to Payerne Airport (VIP) near Lausanne in Switzerland. The transfer marks the project's transition into the final stage of preparations before attempting to demonstrate the aircraft in actual flight at an active airfield.

The H2-Sling is built on a Sling High Wing airframe and uses a hydrogen-electric powertrain instead of a conventional internal combustion engine. The aircraft features a fuel-cell system rated at 100 kW, with maximum propulsion power listed by CELLSIUS at 105 kW following testing. The powertrain includes a 5.6 kWh battery buffer to manage short-duration changes in power demand, such as during takeoff. The aircraft's maximum takeoff weight is listed at 1,050 kg.

Hydrogen fuel is stored under a pressure of 700 bar across two high-pressure tanks located beneath the wings, providing a total storage capacity of 5.2 kg. The two-seat aircraft is designed to achieve a targeted flight range of 125 miles (200 km), approximately two hours of flight time, and a cruise speed of 100 mph (162 km/h). The technological setup mirrors concepts evaluated for larger hydrogen-electric aircraft by pairing sustained fuel-cell power with battery buffering.

CELLSIUS first unveiled the fully integrated H2-Sling in late 2025 and conducted ground tests throughout 2026 while working through legal and regulatory requirements. This new development follows the team's earlier e-Sling project, a battery-electric aircraft that first flew in 2022 with a range of 112 miles (180 km). Local media reports suggest the maiden flight could occur by the end of August, though ETH Zurich has not confirmed the timing.

zh.title: 西班牙F/A-18戰機於羅馬尼亞領空擊落不明無人機
zh.summary: 西班牙空軍F/A-18戰機於羅馬尼亞領空攔截並擊落一架疑似來自俄羅斯的無人機。
body: 北大西洋公約組織（NATO）表示，一架不明飛行器於8月16日當地時間凌晨4時44分，從鄰國摩爾多瓦飛入羅馬尼亞領空，位置位於加拉茨以北約24公里處。該目標首先由羅馬尼亞的空域監測系統發現。
當時正在羅馬尼亞執行北約空中警務任務的一對西班牙F/A-18戰鬥機中，其中一架戰機透過雷達掌握該侵入目標。在獲得授權後，該架F/A-18戰機於當地時間5時01分將無人機擊落，殘骸預計落於兩座村莊之間的無人居住區域。
羅馬尼亞當局並未立即確認該飛行器的來源。北約發言人馬丁·歐唐納上校（Colonel Martin O'Donnell）隨後指出，該架遭擊落的無人機「似乎是俄羅斯的」。

en.title: Spanish F/A-18 Fighter Intercepts and Destroys Drone in Romanian Airspace
en.summary: A Spanish F/A-18 fighter jet destroyed a suspected Russian drone after it entered Romanian airspace from Moldova.
body: An unidentified aircraft entered Romanian airspace from neighboring Moldova about 24 kilometers north of Galați at 04:44 local time on August 16, 2026. The intruder was initially detected by Romania's air-surveillance system.

A pair of Spanish F/A-18 fighters performing NATO air-policing duties in Romania tracked the target on radar. After receiving engagement authorization, a Spanish F/A-18 destroyed the drone at 05:01 local time, with wreckage believed to have landed in an uninhabited area between two villages.
Romania did not immediately identify the origin of the aircraft. NATO spokesman Colonel Martin O'Donnell subsequently stated that the drone appears to be Russian.

facts.sourceQuote: Sunday’s intruder was initially detected by Romania’s surveillance system as it entered from Moldova. The Spanish F/A-18 subsequently established its own radar contact with the target.

zh.title: 印度航空針對全體機師實施強制藥物及酒精檢測
zh.summary: 印度航空對全體機師實施強制藥檢；起因於8月班機巡航急降且機長驗出大麻
body: 印度航空（Air India）已針對旗下所有機師實施強制的藥物與酒精檢測機制。根據路透社取得的內部備忘錄，此項新檢測制度涵蓋禁藥在內的各類物質，並將於航空公司訓練中心、航班結束後的簡報中心以及公司指定的其他地點進行。
印度現行的安全法規要求航空公司隨機抽檢至少10%的機師，但印度航空與其子公司印度航空快運（Air India Express）計劃採取更嚴格的措施。這項新政策起因於8月4日的一起事件，當時一架從普吉島飛往德里的印度航空A320neo客機在巡航時意外驟降約300英呎，造成多名乘客受傷，隨後該機機長在檢測中對大麻呈陽性反應。

en.title: Air India Mandates Drug and Alcohol Testing for All Pilots
en.summary: Air India mandates pilot drug testing after a captain tested positive following an in-flight descent incident.
body: Air India has introduced mandatory drug and alcohol testing for all of its pilots following an in-flight incident. According to an internal memo seen by Reuters, the new testing regime will screen for substances including banned medications. Testing will be conducted at the airline's training centre, at briefing centres after flights, and at other locations determined by the company.

Existing safety regulations in India mandate airlines to randomly test at least 10% of pilots, but Air India and its subsidiary Air India Express plan to exceed this requirement. The policy change follows an August 4 incident when an Air India Airbus A320neo flying from Phuket to Delhi unexpectedly descended about 300 feet during cruise, injuring several passengers. The captain of the flight later tested positive for cannabis.
